items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I played with Sy Oliver's band

ctx.x: Yeah, went to New York and played Roseland Ballroom, and I played with Sy Oliver's band, On the package like it was Basie's band -- Joe Williams; Barney Bigard was over on our side of the fence and Sy. This was a good -- kept everybody on the dancing side.
